title: Vacuum gripping head for an industrial robot

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.quote: The invention relates to a vacuum operated gripping head for an industrial robot.
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum operated gripping head for an industrial robot, which implies a housing and a grip portion, but it does not specify an 'electrically operated' vacuum generating device, only a 'vacuum operated' one.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.quote: The cup 4 and the nipple 6 have an axial hole, like the body 17 of the suction pad 16, with obtaining of an axial passing-through channel in the member 3.
features.note: The gripping member, which acts as a grip portion, is described as having an axial passing-through channel, making it a hollow body.

coord.heading: Detailed description of a preferred embodiment

features.refuted: The quote describes an axial hole/channel through multiple components, not that the grip portion itself is a hollow body.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum system where air is aspirated through the gripping member, but it does not describe guiding exhaust air from a vacuum generating device through the grip portion to an air outlet. The vacuum source is normally outside the head.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: The reference describes a grip unit with a hollow grip portion, but it lacks an electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through the grip to an outlet, and a sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.note: The reference describes a gripping head with a suction pad and a hollow gripping member, but it does not include an electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through the grip to an outlet, or a sound-damping device.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping material lining the grip portion.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference explicitly states that the vacuum source is normally outside the head, not arranged completely within a housing portion of the gripping head itself.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or material in any housing portion.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference describes a gripping member (grip portion) sliding within a sleeve, but not as an elongated structure between two distinct housing portions with an air outlet on a second housing portion.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe an air collection screw or any mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of the grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference does not mention bent or curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not describe a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a gripping member (cup, nipple, suction pad) as an assembly, but does not explicitly state that the entire grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.quote: Said channel is generally denoted by 20 and places in communication the air/vacuum connection 8 with the open gripping section 21.
features.note: The gripping member (grip unit) has a channel (suction opening) that communicates with the gripping section (suction chamber delimited by the suction pad/plate).

claims.note: The reference describes a gripping head for an industrial robot, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.

claims.quote: The invention relates to a vacuum operated gripping head for an industrial robot.
claims.note: The reference discloses a gripping head with a vacuum generating device, but it does not specify an electrically operated vacuum generating device or a grip portion for gripping the unit by hand.
The reference does not describe the grip portion as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
The reference describes a vacuum gripping head for an industrial robot, but it does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
The reference does not disclose a grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a vacuum generating device (vacuum source) connected to the gripping head, but it does not specify its arrangement completely within a first housing portion of the housing.
The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device arranged in a housing portion or the housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference does not describe a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
This reference does not disclose an air collection device, such as an air collection screw, arranged upstream of the grip portion for collecting exhaust air.
This reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of the grip portion to guide exhaust air to an air outlet.
This reference does not disclose a battery coupling point on the housing for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery.
The reference does not mention air baffles or directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.refuted: The assertion requires a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate, but the quote only mentions an open section where vacuum is created without describing these specific structural connections.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripping head for a robot, which shares the broad area of vacuum handling apparatus and some features like a hollow grip portion and fluid connection to a suction chamber, but it lacks key elements of the subject invention such as an electrically operated vacuum gene
